download_r2ibench_dataset: download the R2I-Bench dataset from GitHub and process CSV files into a JSONL prompts file
load_prompts_from_jsonl: load all R2I-Bench prompts from the downloaded JSONL file into a lookup dictionary by key
get_prompt_by_id: get a specific R2I-Bench prompt by its lookup key in the format category_subcategory_id
make_lookup_key: create a lookup key string from category, subcategory, and row ID for R2I-Bench prompts
review_download_function: review the download function that clones the R2I-Bench repo and processes CSV prompt files
